title: White-Label PDF Remediation for Agencies | SignalFeed.dev
description: White-label PDF and document remediation for web agencies and accessibility firms that serve local governments: unbranded files, veraPDF reports, partner pricing from $3 per page, and a free 5-page pilot.
h1: Remediation partners: white-label PDF remediation for agencies
body:
You build and maintain websites, or audit them, for cities, counties, school districts and special districts. Under the ADA Title II web rule (28 CFR part 35, subpart H) those clients must make posted PDFs and Office files conform to WCAG 2.1 Level AA by April 26, 2027 or April 26, 2028, depending on size. Most of them have years of agendas, minutes, budgets and forms to fix. SignalFeed.dev remediates those documents under your name, so you can say yes to the document work without hiring for it.

What you get

  • Unbranded delivery: files come back with no SignalFeed.dev name in the document properties, file names or reports. You deliver them as your own work.
  • veraPDF reports: every PDF is checked against PDF/UA-1 with the open-source veraPDF validator, plus manual checks of reading order, alt text, table headers and form labels. You get the report for each file, ready to pass on.
  • Turnaround: batches of up to 100 standard pages typically return within 5 business days. We confirm the date for each batch before we start, and larger backlogs are scheduled in weekly drops.
  • Your client stays yours: we work only through you, never contact your clients, and never list them as ours.

Partner pricing

Partner rates per unit, before volume discounts
Document typePartner rate
Standard pages: text, headings, lists, images, simple tables$3 per page
Complex pages: multi-level budget or financial tables, dense charts$6 per page
Fillable forms: labeled, tab-ordered form fields$12 per form

Volume discounts: 10% off batches of more than 500 pages a month, and 15% off more than 2,000 pages a month. We quote each batch only after reviewing the actual files, and you set your own price to your client. Scanned or low-quality pages, handwriting, maps, math and very complex tables are quoted case by case, and we may decline them. We don't do JAWS or NVDA screen-reader testing, and we don't issue compliance certifications.

Free 5-page pilot

Send us 5 pages from a real client document, preferably the hardest one you have. We return the remediated file and its veraPDF report at no charge, so you can check the quality before you quote anything. To see sample work first, look at three city documents before and after remediation, with the originals, the finished files and their reports.

US-only processing and confidentiality

  • Files are stored and processed in the United States. SignalFeed.dev is a small US firm: the work uses AI-assisted tooling plus a human review of every file before delivery, and is never passed to subcontractors. If your contract bans AI-assisted processing, tell us and we will decline rather than work around it.
  • We can sign a mutual NDA before the first file arrives (we review any NDA before signing it).
  • Please don't send files containing personal records: Social Security, driver's license or account numbers, medical (PHI), student (FERPA), financial or tax, legal or case, or law-enforcement records, or controlled (CUI) information. We don't accept that work.
  • Files are used only to do the job. We delete them 30 days after delivery, or sooner if you ask.

How to start

Email aaron.signalfeed@gmail.com with your 5 pilot pages, or a rough idea of your clients' backlog. Related guides: ADA Title II and your PDFs and veraPDF PDF/UA errors, explained.
